current_date: Came into effect 12 December 2022; minor corrective updates 3 April 2023
current_evidence: The council's Local List page links 'Local Information Requirements – 03.04.23' (media/9115) as the list in force: 'The Local Requirements List was approved and came into effect on Monday 12th December 2022' with 'minor corrective updates ... on 3.4.2023'. It describes Grokbot's link (media/10122) only as 'Local List Consultation 28 October - 9 December 2024' and does not say the changes were adopted.

issues.detail: Grokbot's Validation list URL (media/10122) is the 2024 consultation draft ('Local Information Requirements - Consultation 2024 v1 update'), not an adopted list. The in-force list is 'Local Information Requirements – 03.04.23' (media/9115). Grokbot read both documents but took most app-type triggers from the draft. Changes proposed only in the draft, such as the BNG and self-build exemption wording that the page says was introduced on page 9, may not be in force.
issues.evidence: Local List page: 'A consultation was run from 28 October to 9 December 2024 for changes to the Local Requirements List'; draft footer quoted by Grokbot: 'Local Requirements List Consultation Version – 28 October 2024 – 9 December 2024 – V1 revision'

issues.detail: The List date 2024-10-01 (Date basis 'Date: 28 October 2024') is the start of a consultation, not an adoption date, and the month was also rounded down to 1 October. The list in force came into effect on 12 December 2022 and was updated on 3 April 2023. 'Outdated (>2y)? = Yes' is still correct, but because the adopted list dates from 2022/23.
issues.evidence: Page: 'approved and came into effect on Monday 12th December 2022'; 'minor corrective updates ... were made on 3.4.2023'

issues.detail: About 12 of the 18 tab_items are process text, contact details, reference lists or page furniture, not requirements. Examples: 'Supporting documents may be submitted by email to planning.development@havant.gov.uk, or through electronic transfer (eg Dropbox or WeTransfer)'; 'We do not require multiple hard copies.'; both document title blocks ('Local Information Requirements ... Implementation Date: 12 December 2022 ... Electronic submission through Planning Portal is recommended'); the list of Local Plan/Neighbourhood Plan documents; the SPD list ('Borough Design Guide SPD (Adopted December 2011) Housing SPD ...'); a page footer ('Local Requirements List Version – 12 Dec 2022; minor updates 3 April 2023 Page 24 of 25'); the BS4142 purchase-link note; the link title 'Natural England's latest guidance on achieving nutrient neutrality'; and a bare list of designated-site types (SAC, SPA, Ramsar, SSSI, NNR, LNR, SINC).
issues.evidence: tab_items under 'Submission rules' and 'Policy-driven requirements (all application types)'

issues.detail: Several rows use text that belongs to a different requirement. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' (Full planning) uses the Arboricultural Method Statement sentence. 'Travel Plan' is a reference list and page footer that runs into the Tree Survey/AIA text, with no Travel Plan trigger. 'Self-build / custom build information' is the BNG Self Build Exemption Claim Form wording, not a self-build requirement. 'Ground investigation / Geotechnical' is a list of SuDS content items (infiltration tests, groundwater levels, runoff calculations). 'Habitats Regulations Assessment' gives the content steps ('Identify the site...') instead of the development types it applies to; the tab text shows the trigger was cut at 'This applies to the following types of development:'.
issues.evidence: Full planning 'Schedule of works' trigger: 'An Arboricultural Method Statement (AMS) must be provided (including a Tree Protection Plan)...'; 'Self-build' trigger: 'Self Build Exemption Claim Form – Part 1 Where an applicant believes that their development is subject to BNG...'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are cut off or are background/content text, not a statement of when the item applies. Flood Risk Assessment ends at '...a sitespecific Flood Risk Assessment (FRA) will be required for'. Design and Access Statement ends at '...outline and full planning permission for'. Marketing (Full planning) is 'A marketing statement is normally required for the following developments:' followed by a page footer. Air Quality is background on Part IV of the Environment Act 1995. CIL is the fragment 'of the CIL Regulations 2010 (as amended).' Site levels/sections is 'Section drawings may also be requested in other cases.' Energy/Sustainability is a sentence fragment. Lighting has empty bullets ('all applications for ▪ ▪ ▪ Street lighting...'). Ventilation is cut off at 'A4 (i.e.'.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows Full planning trigger_excerpt values as quoted

issues.detail: 'Contaminated Land / Land Contamination Assessment' is placed under 'Minerals & waste (county)', a county-matter category. Havant is a district and the trigger says nothing about minerals or waste. The same row is under Householder, although the trigger lists new dwellings over 10 units, known contamination, and landfill proximity 'Excluding householder application'. 'Marketing / vacancy evidence' is placed under 'Change of use - prior approval', but its trigger is a planning application for the loss of a community facility or shop under Local Plan policy DM2, not a prior approval.
issues.evidence: Trigger: 'Any new development of dwellings, greater than 10 units ... Excluding householder application, any site situated within 250 metres of existing or former landfill site'

issues.detail: About 25 rows carry 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' although their own triggers apply more widely. Examples: the Arboricultural Implications Appraisal is required 'for any development' where trees are on or near the site (so also Householder and Outline); FRA and Sequential Test apply to all development in flood risk areas; Parking Plan applies wherever parking demand increases. Some rows are also too narrow. Heritage Statement appears only under Listed building consent, although its trigger covers 'all applications affecting heritage assets', including unlisted buildings in Conservation Areas and their setting (so Householder and Full too). Nutrient Neutrality appears only under Outline, although the trigger shows it applies to full applications as well (the occupancy calculator is waived only 'if it is an outline application and the quantum and mix ... are not known'). Reserved matters is '(none)'.
issues.evidence: AIA trigger: 'required for any development (including construction of access drive, patios...)'; Heritage trigger: 'required for all applications affecting heritage assets'

issues.detail: 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' (Full planning) is a recommendation to use the pre-application service, not a validation requirement.
issues.evidence: 'Applicants are strongly recommended to use the Council's Pre-application Advice and Guidance Service...'

issues.detail: The location plan rule appears twice in tab_items (once from each document), and the Planning Portal intro paragraph appears twice. The 'Biodiversity Checklist' and 'Ecological Survey' rows share the same trigger under both Householder and Full planning, as do 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' and 'Foul Sewage' ('This requirement applies to all major applications'). 'Cycle parking details' repeats the Parking Plan trigger.
issues.evidence: tab_items 2 and 3 ('A plan which identifies the land, to an identified scale (1:1250 or 1:2500)...')

issues.detail: Contents were not compared against the adopted list (media/9115) because the shared WebFetch budget ran out after the Local List page was read. Requirements missing from Grokbot's capture (e.g. any affordable housing, daylight/sunlight or SCI items) therefore could not be listed. Grokbot reports 74 requirement items, but the tab holds only 18 items and most are not requirements.
issues.evidence: WebFetch HTTP 403: 'web-fetch budget for this session is exhausted'

summary: Grokbot links the October–December 2024 consultation draft. According to the council's Local List page, the list in force is still the one effective from 12 December 2022 (updated 3 April 2023), so the link and the 2024-10-01 date are wrong. The extraction mixes the two documents, many tab items are process or reference text, and several triggers come from the wrong requirement. The full content comparison was blocked by the fetch budget.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
